purpose: Independent practice of D2.1 spinner predictions.
student_learning_goal: I can predict spinner outcomes using likelihood.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict spinner outcomes using likelihood.
header.character_watermark: Lucky with a spinner in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at each spinner. Circle the MOST LIKELY outcome.
parts.visual_layout: 4 spinner illustrations stacked, each with options to circle.

image_placeholders.description: 4 spinner illustrations for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Spinner 1: 3/4 red + 1/4 blue. Spinner 2: 4 equal quadrants (red/blue/green/yellow). Spinner 3: 1/2 dog + 1/2 cat. Spinner 4: 1/4 hockey + 3/4 soccer. Below each, 'Most likely: ___' line with options.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_SPINNERS at Part 1: keywords name the visual element and criterion.

parts.answer_key: Spinner 1: red. Spinner 2: any (all equal). Spinner 3: equal. Spinner 4: soccer.

parts.student_instructions: Spin a real spinner 5 times. Predict each spin first.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-column 5-row prediction table for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Header: 'Predict' / 'Result'. 5 rows for spin outcomes. Above the table, a small spinner illustration.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_TABLE at Part 2: keywords name the columns.

parts.answer_key: Any 5 predictions and 5 results filled in.

parts.student_instructions: Design a spinner with 3 colours where ONE is most likely.
parts.visual_layout: A blank circle with 'most likely: ___' line.

image_placeholders.description: A blank circle (~3in diameter) for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Above: 'Design your spinner. Make ONE colour most likely.' Below: 'Most likely: ___' line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_BLANK at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any spinner with one section larger than others.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, predict the LEAST likely outcome on each spinner.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Use Part 1 for formative — children predicting the BIGGEST section.
